visualCharacteristics.purpose: Centered tiles without outline: media on top, bold heading, copy and an optional CTA
visualCharacteristics.layout: Tiles flow 1 per row on mobile, 2 from 600px and 3 from 900px; an incomplete last row is centered (e.g. two tiles sit centered under a three-column width). Media (small :icon:, spot illustration or lifestyle photo) sits above the centered body
visualCharacteristics.notes: Feature icons are :icon: spans (e.g. :lock:, :finance-accounts:, :alert:; SVGs under /icons/). The grey card body behind photo tiles, heading color and CTA pill styling are design-pass details.

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: cell 1 image or :icon:, cell 2 H3 title (sup footnote allowed), paragraph copy, optional CTA link. The media cell may be omitted; empty paragraphs are dropped
rows: H3 title, copy, optional Learn more link

usage.description: Feature, how-to and cross-sell tile rows on debit card promotion pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for 2-3 centered, outline-free tiles with media above copy. For bordered product cards use cards-product; for icon-beside-text step lists use cards-steps.
